one_line: Do not submit now: Amendment 0001 pauses additional BPA admissions, although portable sanitation is a potential fit if admissions reopen.
scope: NSWC Indian Head Division seeks portable restroom rental suppliers for Master BPAs supporting Indian Head, Maryland. Qualified vendors would compete for individual calls below the Simplified Acquisition Threshold; price lists may support direct awards below $10,000.
fit: Restroom facilities, portable sanitation, water delivery, waste removal, maintenance, and nationwide deployment are stated company capabilities.
Relevant experience includes USCG restroom/shower support, Denver portable restroom trailers, and Navy restroom rentals.
Active SAM registration and GSA MAS #47QSMS25D00AM support the stated administrative requirements.
The company states SBE and MBE status. The solicitation requires a small business, without an 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, or HUBZone restriction; size eligibility under NAICS 562991 still needs confirmation.
Indian Head, Maryland falls within the company's stated nationwide work area.
red_flags: Amendment 0001 controls: rolling admissions are paused, with no reopening date supplied.
The amendment directs vendors not to contact the previously listed individuals about BPA status or process and identifies IHD_BPA@us.navy.mil for future inquiries.
The solicitation narrative states a small business set-aside despite the opportunity metadata saying none stated.
NAICS 562991 and PSC W085 are absent from the company's listed codes. Its GSA SINs are 532490P, 561210FS, 561210FAC, and 541614; coverage of this exact requirement is unconfirmed.

The fleet and price list establish restroom trailers, but do not establish available standard portable toilet inventory or standalone accessible portable toilets comparable to recent agency purchases.
No mandatory site visit, bonding requirement, or specific license requirement is stated in the supplied pack; individual call requirements remain unknown.
Master BPA admission provides eligibility to compete for future requirements, not a stated guaranteed order value.
competition: United Contract Solutions is the dominant recurring supplier in the supplied agency history, winning 12 of 15 listed awards, including Indian Head orders of $18,660 and $6,720 in August 2026 with two offers each. Other agency winners include FED Crew, Reliance Contractors, and I-2-I Solutions. No offer count or awardee list is supplied for this Master BPA admission.
price_signal: Relevant Indian Head awards include $18,660 for two standard portable restroom units and one handicap-accessible unit for the listed 2026–2027 period, $6,720 for another 2026–2027 order, and $18,000 and $6,480 for listed 2025–2026 orders. Short Indian Head orders include $630 and $1,440. These are order totals, not established unit rates. Temporary 123's supplied prices cover shower/restroom combination trailers rather than comparable standard portable toilets, and the price list leaves currency and billing basis unspecified. The $10,000–$250,000 opportunity estimate is not a guaranteed BPA value.
must_have: Wait for reopened admissions before submitting; follow any replacement process. Source: Amendment 0001.
Qualify as a small business for the solicitation. Source: solicitation Important Notes.
Provide a cover sheet with official company name, CAGE code, and contact name, phone number, and email address. Source: solicitation interested-company requirements.
Provide documentation of capabilities and expertise; identify GSA contract number if held. Source: solicitation requirements and Important Notes.

Provide at least three past performance references, including organization name, address, contract/order number, award amount, contact, telephone number, and item description. Source: solicitation past performance requirement.

Use the attached Past Performance Questionnaire for reference evaluations covering customer satisfaction, timeliness, technical success, program management, and quality. Source: attachment and announcement attachment instructions; submission routing must be reconciled with the amendment when admissions reopen.
Maintain active SAM registration and either an active PIEE account for invoices and receiving reports or credit card as a payment method. Source: solicitation interested-company requirements.
Complete and return a price list if applicable; catalog prices may support direct awards below $10,000. Source: solicitation requirements and Important Notes.

deadline: Listed response deadline: 2028-11-12; time and time zone are not stated. Original rotation cutoffs are 30 April for June awards and 31 October for December awards, through June 2029. As of 2026-11-17, the October cutoff has passed, and Amendment 0001 pauses admissions without a reopening date.
